Here’s a dead-simple walkthrough plus a helper you can open and use right now.

TL;DR

What 3A is: a small JSON with event + artifacts[].

What you do: build that JSON, then POST it to your Apps Script Web App URL.

I made you a builder page: it assembles the JSON, auto-fills timestamps, computes SHA256, and can POST for you.

1) Open the 3A Payload Builder
